reason: I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and I'm not swapping a person for software with zero published results and 7 seats sold. $147 a month is a real chunk when I'm making $40k a year.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. If it burns my leads and I can't see one customer who got booked calls from it, I've paid $147 to hurt my own pipeline. The card-required trial also makes me think they're counting on me forgetting to cancel, and payments are final after day 4.
would_change_my_mind: Real screenshots or a case study from someone in my niche showing replies and booked calls from the DMs, plus a clear refund if it doesn't book anything in the first month.
